title: 第1章 青元顾安第2章 灵鸡场
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
旭日初升，金光漫过云海，染群峰为红玉，自山腰而下，又有流岚轻锁，仿佛隔开仙域人间，其间恍有松涛喝风，仙鹤衔霞。
这里是青元山脉，因其间坐落有青元宗而得名。
自青元道人云游至此，辟地立宗，大兴土木，广收门徒，已有千二百年，可谓底蕴深厚，源远流长。
其辟土三千里，辖云、陈、赵三国，统凡人千万余。
门下弟子近千，高修频出，金丹传承代代不断。
小千峰的一处院落内。
顾安盘坐在床上，迎着朝阳紫气，神情无悲无喜，身上蓝色灵光明灭不定，已是到了破关的关键时刻。
水元功的灵力沿周天运行，撞上练气中期的屏障，又撞出一道裂痕，此时，屏障上已有七八道裂痕纵横交错。
顾安再次运行灵力，这一次没有直接冲击屏障，而是在屏障前停了下来，蓝色的灵力在此积蓄沸腾，直致经脉再也承受不住。
灵力化作一条水蓝色的怒龙狠狠地轰击在屏障上。
“咔嚓”
屏障碎裂，堵住的灵力一泻千里，如江河般向前奔腾。
炼气中期！突破！
突破后顾安并未着急收功，反而趁着紫气未散，抓紧巩固境界。
这是他多年来养成的习惯，不放过一分一秒的修炼时间。
自六岁入青元宗，如今已有八年。
八年里，顾安朝服紫气，夜引月华，打坐参玄，炼化灵气，未有懈怠。
今日终于突破炼气四层。
“吁”
少顷，顾安缓缓收功，长出一口浊气，那浊气在晨光中竟泛起青蓝两色，如烟似雾，袅袅飘散。

“这便是炼气中期的灵力离体吗？果真玄妙。”
炼气中期，最明显标志便是灵力离体，到了这一步，修仙者再难被凡人所伤，掌握各种驾驭水火的手段，杀伤力大增。
“炼气中期，要学些新法术了。之前学的轻身术，清洁术虽然很方便，可都没什么威力。”
“我是水木土三灵根，水属性最好，木属性次之，土灵根最差。”
“修炼的功法也是水元功，法术的话，之前看的水矛术，水盾术都不错，一攻一防，辅以缠绕术，想来在整个练气中期也够用了。”
“可惜藏经阁二楼都没有水木复合属性的功法，我的木属性也不差。水元功的效率还是太低了，灵力上限和灵力质量也一般，唉，要是天灵根就好了。”
“罢了，能修仙就已经是侥天之幸，不可强求更多。”
想到这，顾安眼神闪烁莫名。
他本不是此界之人，前世是一名蓝星上的大学生，散步时看见有人组织放生活动，便好奇上去围观，但当他看到大妈要将陆龟往海里放，忍不住上前阻止，这本是救下生灵的善举。
但大妈并不愿意讲道理，顾安年纪轻轻，论不讲道理的吵架，自然不是大妈的对手，被大妈的胡搅蛮缠气的一点点红温。
最后，红温中顾安心脏病发作，送往医院抢救无效后死亡。
再醒来时，便已成腹中胎儿，不久后降生此界。
content_en:
As the sun rises, the golden light spreads across the sea of ​​clouds, dyeing the peaks into red jade. Coming down from the mountainside, there are light locks of mist, as if they separate the world from the fairyland. In the meantime, there are pines drinking the wind and cranes holding the clouds.
This is the Qingyuan Mountains, named after the Qingyuan Sect located in it.
It has been twelve hundred years since Taoist Qingyuan traveled here, established a sect, carried out large-scale construction projects, and recruited many disciples. It can be said that it has a profound foundation and a long history.
It covers an area of ​​three thousand miles, governs the three kingdoms of Yun, Chen and Zhao, and rules over tens of millions of mortals.
There are nearly a thousand disciples under his sect, and they frequently come up with high-level cultivation, and the golden elixir is passed down from generation to generation.
In a courtyard of Xiaoqianfeng.
Gu An was sitting cross-legged on the bed, facing the purple light of the morning sun. His expression was neither sad nor happy, and the blue aura on his body was flickering. It was the critical moment to break through.
The spiritual power of Shui Yuan Gong traveled along the sky, hit the barrier in the middle stage of Qi training, and created another crack. At this time, there were seven or eight cracks crisscrossing the barrier.
Gu An used his spiritual power again. This time he did not hit the barrier directly, but stopped in front of the barrier. The blue spiritual power accumulated and boiled here until the meridians could no longer bear it.
The spiritual power turned into an angry aqua dragon and struck hard at the barrier.
"Click"
The barrier shattered, and the blocked spiritual energy surged forward like a river.
The middle stage of Qi refining! breakthrough!
After the breakthrough, Gu An did not rush to finish his work. Instead, he took advantage of the purple energy to consolidate his realm.
This is a habit he has developed over the years, and he never misses a single minute of practice time.
It has been eight years since he entered Qingyuan Sect at the age of six.
In the past eight years, Gu An has been taking purple qi, drawing moonlight at night, meditating and refining spiritual qi, without slacking off.
Today I finally broke through the fourth level of Qi Refining.
"call"
After a while, Gu An slowly finished his work and breathed out a breath of turbid air. The turbid air actually appeared blue and blue in the morning light, drifting away like smoke and mist.
"Is this the spiritual power leaving the body in the middle stage of Qi refining? It's really mysterious."
In the middle stage of Qi refining, the most obvious sign is the separation of spiritual power from the body. At this stage, the cultivator can no longer be hurt by mortals. He can master various means of controlling water and fire, and his lethality is greatly increased.
"In the middle stage of Qi refining, you need to learn some new spells. Although the lightening techniques and cleaning techniques you learned before are very convenient, they are not very powerful."
"I have the three spiritual roots of water, wood, and earth. The water attribute is the best, the wood attribute is second, and the earth spiritual root is the worst."
"The exercises I practice are also Water Elemental Techniques. As for spells, the Water Spear Technique and Water Shield Technique that I saw before are both good. One attack and one defense, supplemented by the entanglement technique. I think it will be enough for the entire middle stage of Qi training."
"It's a pity that there are no techniques with combined water and wood attributes on the second floor of the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion. My wood attributes are not bad either. The efficiency of the water element technique is still too low, and the upper limit of spiritual power and the quality of spiritual power are also average. Alas, it would be better if I had Tianlinggen."
"That's all. Being able to become an immortal is already a blessing. You can't force anything more."
Thinking of this, Gu An's eyes flickered inexplicably.
He is not from this world. In his previous life, he was a college student on Blue Star. When he was walking, he saw someone organizing a life release activity, so he went to watch out of curiosity. However, when he saw the aunt about to release the tortoise into the sea, he couldn't help but stepped forward to stop it. This was originally a kind act to save living creatures.
But Auntie is not willing to be reasonable. Gu An is young and naturally is no match for Auntie when it comes to unreasonable quarrels. Little Hongwen is annoyed by Auntie's nonsense.
In the end, Gu An suffered a heart attack in Hong Wen Zhong and died after being sent to the hospital where rescue efforts failed.
When he wakes up again, he is already a fetus in his belly and will be born in this world soon.
